Silver rewards

Compare averages with averages

The matched KR averages show silver increasing at each tier in both Chaos Rift and Guardian’s Shade. Individual runs vary, so single-clear silver totals should not be treated as an average.

Evidence strength

Direction is stronger than precision

Tier unlocks and improved rewards are confirmed by patch notes. Exact quantities are community reports. The four-run log has a known small sample; the full comparison’s run count is unknown. Verified Astrogem, Relic book and Fate Ember probabilities are still unavailable.

Differences = 1770 reported mean − selected lower-tier reported mean. Percent change = difference ÷ lower-tier mean × 100. Daily projections use clears × characters × loot multiplier. Field Boss projections use roster reward claims only. No exact drop probabilities or confidence intervals can be calculated for the main dataset without its raw observations and sample counts. Fractions are averages, not fractional items in a run.
